title: GLASS & FRAME
summary: Door window glass (all models) and the lift channel bolted along its bottom edge. The channel is bolted to the glass at two holes (A and B), each with a bolt, washer, bushing, special nut and nut; a roller on a stud and a fastener with cap sit at the lower corner of the glass; a roller-and-slider block rides at the end of the channel. The channel is lubricated with 1f.

parts.name: CHANNEL
parts.name_expanded: Channel – door glass lift (bottom of glass)

fastening.to: door glass [1] at holes A and B
fastening.note: "STACK-UP FOR HOLES A&B": bolt [8] goes through washer [7], the glass hole, bushing [6], special nut [5] and the channel [2], and is secured by nut [4] on the far side of the channel, 35-50 LBS IN. The stack is drawn in full at hole B; hole A shows the same stack unlabelled.

fastening.to: door glass [1] at its lower corner
fastening.note: Roller assembly [9] (stud with roller) passes through special washer [10] and bushing [6] into a hole near the glass corner; washer [7], special washer [10] and nut [4] go on the other side, 35-50 LBS IN.

fastening.to: door glass [1] at its lower corner edge
fastening.note: Fastener [11] goes through a hole at the corner of the glass; cap [12] fits over it from the other side (dashed line). What part it retains is not shown.
